text: Two of #227's ratified acceptance tests are corrected where they assumed what real pip and Docker don't do. The merger found this running the real Docker and PyPI suite on #302's head, which the factory's sandbox, having no Docker, can't run. Their pinned-pip comparison called ParsedLine.is_requirement, which pip 26.2.1, the pinned base's pip, doesn't have; it now asks whether the line's requirement is None, as the production parser does. The proxy test's Docker-config fixture kept the client's contexts but not its CLI plugins, so Docker fell back to the legacy builder, which can't build linux/amd64 on an arm64 host. It now names the original plugin directory with cliPluginsExtraDirs and keeps buildx's own state elsewhere. Its check that the gate leaves the client's configuration alone now compares config.json and the contexts, the configuration it wrote, since the Docker CLI keeps state of its own beside them. Every other check in both tests is unchanged. @gitdek approved fixing these tests by hand ("yes go ahead").
